description: Land Title Settlement Department - Ulakkonda, Udunuwara D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320271
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determinations by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extents, owner information, and land access rights. The content is focused on land ownership and property rights, falling squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
